data.name: Jimit
data.gender_notes: Jimit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is victorious, one who conquers all. The name Jimit carries the meaning “Victorious One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Jimit usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who has achieved spiritual victory and has conquered their inner demons
data.etymology: Jimit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jimit total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Jimit' in Hindu culture signifies strength, power, and superiority. It inspires the bearer to strive for excellence, succeed in their endeavors, and be victorious. This name is associated with valor, courage, and physical dominance, making it an impressive choice for someone seeking a strong and empowering name.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name 'Jimit' holds deep significance as it imparts the message of inner strength, self-confidence, and resilience. It's a reminder for the person to believe in themselves, overcome challenges, and continue moving forward even during difficult times. This name is not just a symbol of earthly accomplishments but also represents the fulfillment of spiritual growth and engagement with higher truths. In essence, it is a call to be a warrior, not only in your external battles but also in the inner struggle towards self-realization and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jimit: Radiant wisdom, the enlightened soul shining brightly.
